teaser_copy.seo_title: Dragon Headshots: Generative Portrait Studies with Art Nouveau and Art Deco Cues
teaser_copy.seo_description: A decorative portrait series exploring dragon head silhouettes and geometric ornament with a generative pipeline and disciplined finishing.
teaser_copy.page_subtitle: Decorative dragon portraits with geometric ornament and crisp silhouettes.
tile_text: Geometric ornament and crisp silhouette control

page_copy.pattern: Decorative portrait work leans on clear silhouettes, controlled highlights, and repeatable ornamental motifs that read cleanly at tile scale.
page_copy.action: A generative first pass defined silhouette and motif rhythm, then in painting refined edge discipline, highlight placement, and line weight.
page_copy.measured: Produces a cohesive portrait set that reads instantly in grids and carries enough detail for print, social showcases, and provenance linked digital editions.
